crossRefs.note: But I trust in your loving kindness. My heart rejoices in your salvation.
The king rejoices in your strength, Yahweh! How greatly he rejoices in your salvation!
For our heart rejoices in him, because we have trusted in his holy name.
Let Mount Zion be glad! Let the daughters of Judah rejoice because of your judgments.
The righteous shall rejoice when he sees the vengeance. He shall wash his feet in the blood of the wicked,
so that men shall say, “Most certainly there is a reward for the righteous. Most certainly there is a God who judges…
Let God arise! Let his enemies be scattered! Let them who hate him also flee before him.
Hannah prayed, and said: “My heart exults in Yahweh! My horn is exalted in Yahweh. My mouth is enlarged over my…
I will greatly rejoice in Yahweh! My soul will be joyful in my God, for he has clothed me with the garments of…
yet I will rejoice in Yahweh. I will be joyful in the God of my salvation!
Mary said, “My soul magnifies the Lord.
My spirit has rejoiced in God my Savior,
But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faith,
Finally, my brothers, rejoice in the Lord! To write the same things to you, to me indeed is not tiresome, but for you…

translations.web: My soul shall be joyful in Yahweh. It shall rejoice in his salvation.
translations.bsb: Then my soul will rejoice in the LORD and exult in His salvation.
translations.kjv: And my soul shall be joyful in the LORD: it shall rejoice in his salvation.
translations.asv: And my soul shall be joyful in Jehovah: It shall rejoice in his salvation.
